Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Hazy morning in Johor Bahru? Keep your walk indoors and keep sipping water. 🌫️ In Episode 3 of our Uncle Lim series, a stranger takes Uncle Lim's kopitiam seat and suggests he skip his outdoor walk. Uncle Lim goes anyway and comes back with itchy eyes and a scratchy throat. At Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall, there's a surprise waiting behind the counter. Simple habits for haze days: - Check the air quality reading before heading out - Walk laps indoors at KSL City Mall instead - Sip water through the day - Add guava or papaya to your meals - If breathing feels uncomfortable, see a doctor Not sure what to do on a hazy day? Walk in for a Minute Consult with our pharmacists, or ask about Dietitian and Nutrition Counselling. No appointment needed. Lot G-001, Ground Floor, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru. Open daily, 10AM to 10PM.
